=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:621-636 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `latest_scoped_run_field` can return an empty string for a valid JSON payload with no scoped match, so the workflow loses the activity signal at the helper boundary.
  WHY: Under API indexing lag or a late-created run, the helper returns nothing instead of retrying or escalating, which is the same failure mode the PR was trying to eliminate.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:675-689 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PLAN_RUN_STATUS assignment turns the empty scoped lookup into `unknown` without any dedicated retry or backoff, so the poll loop can proceed toward `plan_failed` while the real Plan run is still active.
  WHY: Capture_run_id retries, but the main poll loop does not distinguish "no match yet" from "run is still in flight," allowing the v1.13.5 flake to recur.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:391-403 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new step output name `title` is overly generic and can collide with other uses of the same identifier.
  WHY: Downstream references like `${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.title }}` become a latent contract break if the output name is shadowed or renamed later.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:38-40 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The ordering check uses a substring search for `continue`, so an unrelated intervening line containing that substring can make the test pass against the wrong location.
  WHY: This is test-only fragility; a future comment or line with `continue` could mask a regression in the retry-branch ordering.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
